title: Replace the 5.0L crankshaft front seal
introduction:
This job renews the seal around the front of the crankshaft, behind the crankshaft pulley. You will clear access, remove the pulley and old seal, install the new seal with the specified tools, then refit and tighten the pulley in stages. Protecting the sealing surfaces matters just as much as fitting the new part.

Read the whole sequence before starting, especially the sealant’s 5-minute securing requirement and the bolt’s torque-and-angle stages. Have a diagnostic scan tool capable of **Misfire Monitor Neutral Profile Correction** available for the finish; a basic code reader may not provide that function. The final step also includes a road test.

items.detail: Front crank seal and damper installer.

items.name: 303-335 (T88T-6701-A)
items.detail: Front-cover oil-seal installer; use only its plate for installing the new seal. Tool kits TKIT-1988-FLM and TKIT-1988-F.

items.name: 303-409 (T92C-6700-CH)
items.detail: Crankshaft seal remover. Tool kits TKIT-1992-FH/FMH/FLMH and TKIT-1993-LMH/MH.

items.name: Strap wrench and Three Leg Puller
items.detail: Used for the pulley operations shown below.

items.name: Torque and angle measurement
items.detail: Needed to carry out the specified tightening stages; no socket size is supplied here.

items.name: Diagnostic scan tool
items.detail: Must support the specified Misfire Monitor Neutral Profile Correction procedure.

items.name: New crankshaft pulley bolt

items.name: Clean engine oil

edits.text: Tools for the job
Materials
Removal — clear access and remove the old seal
Remove these items in the order shown, using each linked procedure:
Remove the [Cooling Fan Motor and Shroud](#/document/G1694592) using its 303-03C Engine Cooling - 5.0L 32V Ti-VCT, Removal and Installation procedure.
edits.why: This clears the working area in front of the engine.

edits.text: Remove the [Accessory Drive Belt](#/document/G1688132) using its 303-05C Accessory Drive - 5.0L 32V Ti-VCT, Removal and Installation procedure.
Remove the [Air Conditioning (A/C) Compressor Belt](#/document/G1688134) using its 303-05C Accessory Drive - 5.0L 32V Ti-VCT, Removal and Installation procedure.
Take out the crankshaft pulley bolt and remove its washer.
edits.why: Keep track of the washer: it will be reused with the new bolt.

edits.text: Use the 3 Leg Puller together with the crankshaft pulley bolt to draw the pulley off. General equipment: Three Leg Puller.
edits.why: The puller applies the removal force through the arrangement shown in the drawing.

edits.text: Dispose of the removed crankshaft pulley bolt.
NOTICE: Protect the engine front cover and crankshaft as you remove the seal. Damage to either surface must be avoided.
Remove the front oil seal with special service tool 303-409 (T92C-6700-CH), Remover, Crankshaft Seal, then discard the seal.
edits.why: The old seal will not be reused.

edits.text: Installation — fit the seal and rebuild the drive
Apply clean engine oil to the engine front-cover bore and the new crankshaft front oil seal’s inner lip.
edits.why: Clean engine oil reduces dry friction at the specified contact surfaces while the seal is fitted. This helps the seal move into position without its lip dragging dry against the mating surface.

edits.text: NOTE: For this seal-installation operation, use only the plate from tool 303-335.
Fit the new crankshaft front oil seal with special service tools 303-1531, Installer, Front Crank Seal and Damper, and the plate from 303-335 (T88T-6701-A), Installer, Front Cover Oil Seal.
edits.why: The installer guides the seal into the cover while applying controlled fitting force. Keeping the seal aligned helps its lip sit evenly around the crankshaft.

edits.text: NOTE: Secure the assembly within 5 minutes of applying the sealant. If that time is exceeded, remove the sealant and clean the sealing area before proceeding. Ignoring this requirement can lead to an oil leak later.
Put Motorcraft Silicone Gasket and Sealant TA-30 (WSE-M4G323-A4) into the Woodruff key slot in the crankshaft pulley.
edits.why: The slot is a specific sealing location; use the close-up to identify it.

edits.text: Before fitting the crankshaft pulley, coat its sealing surface with clean engine oil.
edits.why: This is the surface that meets the seal lip.

edits.text: Install the crankshaft pulley with special service tools 303-335 (T88T-6701-A), Installer, Front Cover Oil Seal, and 303-1531, Installer, Front Crank Seal and Damper.
edits.why: The specified installer keeps the pulley aligned with the crankshaft while fitting force is applied. The tool arrangement gives you controlled movement as the pulley seats on the shaft.

edits.text:
Hold the pulley with the Strap Wrench and fit a new crankshaft pulley bolt with the original washer. Carry out all four stages in order:

| Stage | Action |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Tighten to 103 lb.ft (140 Nm) |
| 2 | Loosen 360° |
| 3 | Tighten to 74 lb.ft (100 Nm) |
| 4 | Tighten a further 90° |
edits.why: The loosening stage is intentional. Do not stop after the first torque setting or combine the stages into a single tightening operation.

edits.text: Refit the following items in this order, using their individual installation procedures:
Install the [Air Conditioning (A/C) Compressor Belt](#/document/G1688134) following 303-05C Accessory Drive - 5.0L 32V Ti-VCT, Removal and Installation.
Install the [Accessory Drive Belt](#/document/G1688132) following 303-05C Accessory Drive - 5.0L 32V Ti-VCT, Removal and Installation.
Install the [Cooling Fan Motor and Shroud](#/document/G1694592) following 303-03C Engine Cooling - 5.0L 32V Ti-VCT, Removal and Installation.
When the mechanical repair is complete, use the diagnostic scan tool to perform Misfire Monitor Neutral Profile Correction.
edits.why: This is a required completion procedure. If your tool cannot perform it, arrange access to one that can.

edits.text: Road-test the vehicle after completing the repair and correction procedure.
edits.why: This is the final operational check in the procedure.
